hyperedges.description: These documents govern the research workflow from recommendation replay and Research Lab UX through score threshold governance and factor-layer traceability.

These safety and validation artifacts keep changes non-destructive: financial float checks guard numeric precision, legacy test governance removes misleading coverage, and healthcheck/UI smoke plans verify current UI behavior without high-risk writes.
The app_icon.png asset is best understood as the desktop application's compact brand or launcher identity: a muted cat-like head icon, not an operational UI screenshot or finance data visualization.

hyperedges.description: These documents govern the research workflow from recommendation replay and Research Lab UX through score threshold governance and factor-layer traceability.

These safety and validation artifacts keep changes non-destructive: financial float checks guard numeric precision, legacy test governance removes misleading coverage, and healthcheck/UI smoke plans verify current UI behavior without high-risk writes.
The app_icon.png asset is best understood as the desktop application's compact brand or launcher identity: a muted cat-like head icon, not an operational UI screenshot or finance data visualization.
